text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Admirable! I could not be more proud to have her as a student of our academy!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I expect you to continue these wholehearted efforts! Ever forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's apparently very pleased with the way we're conducting our practice sessions.
